description: First-500-stored-draw probe values transcribed from the tables of docs/research/dp_gibbs_results.md (Sections 4 and 5), for the delta table of the artifact-backed replication report. The note's probe numbers are the first 500 stored draws per chain; the report compares its own first-500 slice against them. Rows listed under not_comparable cannot match by construction and are excluded from the hard gate; not_comparable_notes records why for each of them (three in total: the note's Figure 1 prior width and Figure 2 prior band, both sample estimates from the probe's 200 prior draws, and n_eta_above_grid, a count rather than a summary). The Figure 5c probability is the note's first-500 value (0.890); the note also records 0.901 for the full run.

5.1.description: Probe values from the Section 4 tables of dp_gibbs_results.md.

not_comparable_notes.figure_1.nu_prior_95_width: The note's prior width is a sample estimate from the probe's 200 prior draws, not the exact gamma quantile the report computes: gamma.ppf(0.975) - gamma.ppf(0.025) is 5.92 / 53.29 / 132.12, while the note's 6.1 / 61 / 117 are 3 percent above, 14 percent above and 11 percent below those values and sit at the 72nd / 95th / 14th percentile of the 200-draw sampling distribution of the same statistic (4000 simulated probes, seeds 0-3999). A 14 percent error is unreachable for an exact quantile, so the row cannot match a report that computes the prior law exactly. The acceptance clause it feeds (posterior narrower than prior) holds either way: 3.27 < 5.92, 6.48 < 53.29, 8.96 < 132.12.
not_comparable_notes.figure_2.prior_band_width: The probe drew the Figure 2 prior band 200 times, the run draws 1,000; the band's width changes in the third decimal.

5.2.description: Probe values from the Section 5 tables of dp_gibbs_results.md.

not_comparable_notes.figure_5.n_eta_above_grid: A per-fit count of quantiles censored to +inf, not a summary; recorded for the reader, never differenced.
